en: Dependent on a state that is included (pariyāpanna) and wholesome (kusala), a state that is not included and is neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome arises by way of root-condition (hetupaccaya).
Dependent on a state that is not included and is wholesome, a state that is not included and is neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome arises by way of root-condition.
There are two [answers] for root; ... pe ... there are two for non-disappearance (avigata).

Dependent on a state that is included [in the mundane] and unwholesome, there arises a state that is not included [in the mundane] and not unwholesome by way of root-condition. Under root [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, one. (The indeterminate roots [function] by way of two conditions.)
